meta.name: story-short-scan
meta.description: 短篇网文扫榜。分析知乎盐言、七猫、黑岩、点众等平台热门短篇数据，捕捉风口题材。触发方式：/story-short-scan、/短篇扫榜、「短篇什么火」「知乎故事排行」。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 扫一遍热门短篇榜单,看清哪些题材正在起量
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你写短篇网文,想快速判断该跟什么题材
copy.tagline_en: Scan trending short-story charts to see which genres are heating up
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you write short web fiction and want to know which genres are trending

howto.what: 装好后 Claude 会当短篇网文市场分析师：基于榜单样本产出扫榜报告，含市场概况、情绪热度排行、题材热点、风口预警和值得写的方向，并写进输出目录的文件。
howto.when: 当你输入 /story-short-scan 或 /短篇扫榜，或提到「短篇什么火」等说法时触发；它属于短篇流水线的第 1/3 步。

say.text: 帮我扫一下点众短篇的榜，看看最近什么题材火
say.note: 它会先确认平台和方向，再抓榜分析

say.text: 我想写虐恋方向，针对这个方向做一次深度扫榜
say.note: 按你的方向深度扫榜并输出报告

say.text: 知乎盐言我发你榜单截图，帮我看看情绪热度排行
say.note: 无脚本平台靠你提供的榜单数据分析

howto.what_en: Claude becomes a short-form web-fiction market analyst: from ranking samples it outputs a scan report covering market overview, emotion heat ranking, topic hotspots, trend warnings and writable directions, saved to the output folder.
howto.when_en: Triggered by /story-short-scan, /短篇扫榜, or mentions like "what's hot in short fiction"; it is step 1/3 of the short-fiction pipeline.

say_en.text: Scan the Dianzhong short-story rankings and tell me which topics are hot
say_en.note: It first confirms platform and direction, then fetches and analyzes

say_en.text: I want to write angsty romance - do a deep scan for that direction
say_en.note: Deep scan on your direction, then a report

say_en.text: Here's a screenshot of Zhihu Yanyan rankings; show me the emotion heat ranking
say_en.note: Platforms without scripts rely on the rankings you provide
